name: raw-list-containers
description: Raw <ul>, <ol>, <dl> usages — typically a sign that <Stack as="ul"> or a list molecule should be used instead, since native list elements bring default browser styling and gap rules that fight tokens.

anyOf.reason: Compose <Stack as="ul" gap={4}> or a list molecule.
Compose <Stack as="ol" gap={4}> or an ordered-list molecule.
Compose <KeyValueList> or an equivalent definition-list molecule.
